title.zh: 森林乐曲失去的最后一音

description.en: An original branching forest tale in three to four choices. Follow a broken rhythm to an echo, a chorus or a deliberate quiet ending.
description.zh: 用3至4次选择走进原创森林分支短篇。沿着断开的节奏，走向回声、合奏，或主动留下的安静结尾。

introduction.en: In this paper forest, a tune stops one note before its ending. Talking trees ask what should come next. You can follow a sound, invite another voice or let a pause remain. The result is a story ending, not a hearing or musical aptitude test.
introduction.zh: 纸上森林里，一段曲子在最后一音前停住。会说话的树问接下来该是什么。你可以跟随声音、邀请另一声部，或让停顿留下。结果是故事结局，不测听力或音乐天赋。

focus.en: Responding to an unfinished fictional tune through repetition, collaboration or a chosen silence.
focus.zh: 面对未完成的虚构旋律，选择重复、合作或主动安静。

prompt.en: The tune breaks off beside a hollow tree. You first…
prompt.zh: 曲子在空心树旁停住，你先……

label.en: Follow the faint repeat coming from the next clearing.
label.zh: 跟着下一处空地传来的轻轻重复声。

label.en: Ask the gathered paper birds what they want to add.
label.zh: 问聚着的纸鸟想添什么。

prompt.en: The clearing repeats every note except the missing one. You…
prompt.zh: 空地重复了除缺失音以外的每一音，你会……

label.en: Repeat one short phrase and listen for its return.
label.zh: 重复一个短乐句，等待它回来。

label.en: Carry the unfinished phrase back to the paper birds.
label.zh: 把未完乐句带回纸鸟那里。

prompt.en: Each paper bird offers a different final note. You…
prompt.zh: 每只纸鸟提供不同的最后一音，你会……

label.en: Invite them to make one shared ending in turns.
label.zh: 邀请它们轮流接成一个共同结尾。

label.en: Ask whether the tune might end with a pause instead.
label.zh: 问曲子能否用一次停顿结束。

prompt.en: The hollow tree offers you a last choice. You choose…
prompt.zh: 空心树给出最后选择，你选……

label.en: A brief echo of the opening phrase.
label.zh: 开头乐句的一次短回声。

label.en: A pause that lets the forest remain unfinished tonight.
label.zh: 让森林今晚暂留未完的一次停顿。

prompt.en: The shared tune reaches its final beat. You…
prompt.zh: 共同曲子来到最后一拍，你会……

label.en: Let the birds’ different notes close together as a chorus.
label.zh: 让纸鸟不同音符以合奏收尾。

label.en: Leave one beat empty so another visitor can continue tomorrow.
label.zh: 空一拍，留给明天来客接续。

summary.en: Your forest closes by bringing back a piece of its beginning. The missing ending does not need a brand-new invention; a short return gives the tune a recognizable shape. This is the route you chose in a tale, not a measure of musical preference.
summary.zh: 你的森林通过带回一段开头来收尾。缺失结尾不必全新发明，一次短返回就让曲子形状可辨。这是短篇所选路线，不衡量音乐偏好。

example.en: A small handmade booklet might end by repeating the shape from its first page, giving the reader a familiar place to arrive.
example.zh: 一本小手作册，可以在末页重复首页形状，让读者有个熟悉的抵达处。

strength.en: A returning element can connect an ending to what came before and make a modest creative piece feel held together.
strength.zh: 返回的元素能把结尾与前文连接，让一件小创作整体相连。

tradeoff.en: Repetition can become automatic if it never changes with the story. A return is more satisfying when it still fits what happened along the way.
tradeoff.zh: 重复若从不随故事变化，也会变自动动作。返回仍贴合途中经历时，更容易满足。

experiment.en: Finish one tiny creative piece by revisiting a detail from its beginning. Adjust it slightly to reflect what the piece became.
experiment.zh: 完成一件微型创作时，重访开头细节，再稍作调整，让它对应作品后来长成的样子。

summary.en: Your missing note becomes a shared ending made from different contributions. The tune does not need every bird to sing identically. It closes because the separate voices have found a moment they can make together.
summary.zh: 你缺失的一音变成了不同贡献构成的共同结尾。曲子不要求每只鸟唱得一样，而是因各个声部找到可一起完成的瞬间而收束。

example.en: In a group drawing, you might let each person add one final small mark rather than asking the most confident artist to finish everybody’s work.
example.zh: 群体绘画里，你可能让每人添一个最后小笔迹，而不是让最自信的画者包办所有收尾。

strength.en: A shared ending can keep the contributors visible and make completion feel like an event the group participated in together.
strength.zh: 共同结尾能让贡献者可见，也让完成像一件大家共同参与的事件。

tradeoff.en: Coordination can be tiring if every tiny decision needs everyone. One bounded final contribution can work better than keeping the whole piece open forever.
tradeoff.zh: 每个小决定都要人人参与时，配合会累。一次有边界的最后贡献，可能比永远开放更合适。

experiment.en: For a small shared project, invite one optional finishing contribution from each interested person and agree on when the piece will be complete.
experiment.zh: 给一个共同小项目，邀请每位愿意的人提供一次可选收尾贡献，并约清什么时候算完成。

summary.en: Your forest lets the last beat stay empty. The silence is chosen rather than repaired, and tomorrow’s visitor may hear the opening differently. The ending allows a small creative experience to remain open without turning every gap into a duty.
summary.zh: 你的森林让最后一拍空着。安静是主动选择，不是等待修补；明天来客也许会以不同方式听开头。结局允许小创作开放，不把每个空缺都变成义务。

example.en: You might leave a spare page in a shared sketchbook so a future visitor can begin there, rather than filling every space before handing it over.
example.zh: 你可能在共同速写本留一页，供以后来客从那里开始，不在交出去前填满每处空白。

strength.en: A deliberate open space can make continuation possible without requiring the current maker to decide every future contribution in advance.
strength.zh: 主动留白使接续成为可能，不要求当前创作者提前决定所有未来贡献。

tradeoff.en: An open ending may confuse people who expected a finished piece. Naming the choice helps distinguish invitation from an overlooked task.
tradeoff.zh: 期待成品的人可能对开放结尾困惑。说明这是选择，能分清邀请与遗忘任务。

experiment.en: Leave one small optional space in a creative exchange and label it as an invitation. Let the next person decide whether to use it.
experiment.zh: 在创作交换里留一个小型可选空间，标明是邀请，再让下一人决定是否使用。
